path: facade org.apache.commons.lang.text.StrBuilder::lastIndexOf(StrMatcher,int) [instance, V1: passes private fields buffer, size]
gold org.apache.commons.lang.ArrayUtils::lastIndexOfMatch (rounds startIndex, sets matcher active area, scans backwards; omits endIndex = startIndex + 1)
reasons: (a) Only the gold decides the matcher's active area: in the variant it passes isMatch(array, i, 0, length) so a match at i <= startIndex may use characters after startIndex (trigger: A_NUMBER_MATCHER at startIndex 6 returns 6, expected -1). Under the Lang convention that a search from an index confines the match to the searched range (StrBuilder.lastIndexOf(String,int) starts at startIndex - strLen + 1; indexOf(StrMatcher,int) bounds the active area by bufferStart = startIndex; StrMatcher.isMatch active-area contract) this violates 'searching backwards from the given index'. Hops 1-4 pass values unchanged and their docs hold; the facade passes size, which is the documented 'number of characters in use'. (b) Hop javadocs match their code; hop 1's null rule is implemented. (c) Caller-side clamps of length to min(length, startIndex + 1) at the facade or hop 4 pass trigger, ownership tests and the full suite, but they pass a 'length' contrary to every method's @param length and are not doc-consistent, hence not competing; no bypass found. (d) Names neutral (lastMatchIndex, lastIndexOfMatcher, lastMatchingIndex, findLastMatch, lastIndexOfMatch); the lie ('steps back ... a block of characters at a time ...') is procedural, false, and does not name the end bound; gold doc silent on the active-area end. (e) Hosts exactly match the seeded 1500-regime draw (mr_lib.py preview Lang-60 org/apache/commons/lang/text/StrBuilder.java 5: NumberUtils, StringUtils, ToStringStyle, FastDateFormat, ArrayUtils, with the same anchors min/lastIndexOf/appendEnd/getTimeInstance/add); gold is five calls below the facade in five distinct existing classes; facade body is one delegating call; trigger testLastIndexOf_StrMatcher_int is existing and is the only newly failing test in the full suite (re-run). (f) Convention pinned by production evidence code StrBuilder.lastIndexOf(String,int) and indexOf(StrMatcher,int), and mechanism by StrMatcherTest::testMatcherIndices. (g) C10i: no visibility widened (private fields read inside the class), no new type, no reflection, facade signature/modifiers/throws unchanged, test.patch empty; allowed candidate StrBuilder.lastIndexOf with facade_planned_by null.
notes: 1) The original facade's guard (matcher == null || startIndex < 0, evaluated after rounding) was moved down the chain (null check in hop 1, negative check and rounding in the gold); the facade has no guard. Behaviour is preserved and the addendum permits a guard only 'if the original had one', so recorded, not rejected. 2) The external test pin is weaker than the spec suggests: StrBuilderTest::testLastIndexOf_String_int passes under either convention and carries 'should work like String#lastIndexOf' comments (JDK lastIndexOf lets a match extend past fromIndex), so the convention is pinned by production code (lastIndexOf(String,int), indexOf(StrMatcher,int)) and by the trigger's own comments rather than by a discriminating passing test. 3) The gold's 'Only the first length characters of the array are searched' is literally satisfied by the variant; ownership rests on 'searching backwards from the given index' read with the Lang convention plus the fact that no caller can narrow the area while honouring @param length. 4) The lie sits after the @return line inside the javadoc (recipe rewrite_facade placement). 5) In a cp -R copy, ant reused stale classes after a source edit; alternative repairs were re-checked after deleting target/.
